title: Long-form content
description: A case study layout for a portfolio, agency or customer-story page, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Button and Skeleton primitives: a kicker, a serif heading and a lead, a list of project facts, then titled sections of paragraphs with a pull-quote after the first one (the words in the serif face, the speaker with an Avatar, a name and a role) and one call to action, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the lead steps up and the quote moves inward at @sm, the heading and the quote step up and the facts go to one row at @md, and the facts move beside the story with more room above and below at @lg.
